note: One line per row of what the accepted core contract (redact-secret #1228/#1229/#1230, merge db0e5c8d per-row tables) says, and what it leaves unresolved. Condensed by the benchmarks side for the final reports; the product records are the source. This repository records and does not decide product policy.

adobe:oauth-server-to-server-client-secr.policy: Bounded-context fallback: the client_secret form or query parameter of the client_credentials request. No bare detector.
adobe:oauth-server-to-server-client-secr.unresolved: Bare p8e- plus 32 characters rests on two rule artifacts of unstated basis; hyphen in the body.

adobe:oauth-web-app-client-secret.policy: Bounded-context fallback: the Authorization Basic envelope of the token, refresh and revoke requests, whole undecoded value (public client id half included).
adobe:oauth-web-app-client-secret.unresolved: No grammar recorded; subtype unattributed (tie to Group D).

adobe:enterprise-web-app-client-secret.policy: Bounded-context fallback: the client_secret form parameter beside org_id.
adobe:enterprise-web-app-client-secret.unresolved: No grammar recorded; subtype unattributed (tie to Group D).

airtable:personal-access-token.policy: Bounded-context fallback: Authorization Bearer; the api_key URL parameter is documented as unsupported.
airtable:personal-access-token.unresolved: Opaque by provider statement; the pat.14.64-hex layout is two maintainers' artifacts and constrains nothing; format may change.

dropbox:access-token.policy: Bounded-context fallback: Authorization Bearer and the access_token response member, at any length.
dropbox:access-token.unresolved: Opaque, may exceed 1 KB; sl. and a 130+ run are three artifacts with different bounds.

hubspot:private-app-access-token.policy: Bounded-context fallback: Authorization Bearer; the tokenKey body field of the token-information request.
hubspot:private-app-access-token.unresolved: pat-na1-/pat-eu1- is one maintainer's artifact; era-limited (legacy private apps being disabled).

contentful:cma-personal-access-token.policy: Bounded-context fallback: Authorization Bearer on the creation endpoint's documented form.
contentful:cma-personal-access-token.unresolved: CFPAT- begins provider placeholders only; length 43 versus 40+ versus a 64-hex example; bare member of the create response is the bare-token question (#1256 under #1241).

jfrog:reference-token.policy: Era-specific, unresolved: the X-JFrog-Art-Api header or the basic-authentication password.
jfrog:reference-token.unresolved: Two provider statements (64 and 128 characters) kept apart; the curl -u password carrier is #1247; era tie to Group E.

meta:app-secret.policy: Bounded-context fallback: the client_secret parameter; the {app-id}|{app-secret} composite is decided in Group D (one span over the whole pair).
meta:app-secret.unresolved: 32 characters is artifact scope, alphabet not settled; a bare value is never attributable.

salesforce:oauth-refresh-token.policy: Bounded-context fallback: the refresh_token request parameter and response member (a token-endpoint field, never a resource Bearer credential).
salesforce:oauth-refresh-token.unresolved: 5Aep861 prefix rests on two artifacts of unconfirmed independence; remainders 80 versus 40.

x:oauth1-consumer-secret.policy: Unresolved: the secret is a signing-key input and no transported carrier is named.
x:oauth1-consumer-secret.unresolved: Carrier; 50 versus 35 to 44 characters; percent-containing forms are outside the raw-input contract.

algolia:admin-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection; role is metadata only. The x-algolia-api-key header is read like every role's key; the application id beside it is silent.
algolia:admin-api-key.unresolved: None asserted beyond the create-key request carrier.

algolia:search-only-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection; frontend-safe documentation does not justify silence or an admin attribution (same type, action, span as the admin key).
algolia:search-only-api-key.unresolved: Carrier unresolved for scoring: no must-flag Case; observed only.

algolia:secured-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection; derived value, not decoded.
algolia:secured-api-key.unresolved: Encoding and whether the parent key is recoverable; observed only.

algolia:write-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection; ACL role is metadata.

algolia:analytics-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection; no alias (a distinct key kind or an ACL profile is unresolved).

algolia:monitoring-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection; role is metadata only.

algolia:usage-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection; the usage-endpoint deprecation is undated so no era.

contentful:delivery-api-access-token.policy: Shared generic detection; public or confidential status unresolved, so no silence. Bearer, access_token query parameter and accessToken property are read.
contentful:delivery-api-access-token.unresolved: Whether a Delivery token may be public; no must-flag Case; observed and controls only.

contentful:preview-api-access-token.policy: Shared generic detection; distinct from Delivery by host and context only.
contentful:preview-api-access-token.unresolved: Not separable from Delivery by value; observed only.

asana:service-account-token.policy: Shared generic detection; no alias to the PAT.
asana:service-account-token.unresolved: No service-account carrier example exists; observed only.

dropbox:app-auth-token.policy: Shared generic detection; Authorization Bearer read as bearer_token; the Basic envelope over app key and secret is read whole.

elastic:cross-cluster-api-key.policy: Shared generic detection where the carrier is shared; the api_key member is read.
elastic:cross-cluster-api-key.unresolved: The keystore is not a wire carrier; the encoded member (base64 id:api_key) is not a read name when it has no api_key sibling (disclosed blind spot).

elastic:serverless-project-api-key.policy: Authorization ApiKey over the undecoded value: authorization_credential, redact, no Elastic attribution (the #1212 reading); no alias to the stack key.

figma:plan-access-token.policy: Shared generic detection; X-Figma-Token read as contextual_secret; no PAT subtype; a bare figd_ value is silent.

figma:cli-plan-access-token.unresolved: CLI and npm-registry carriers unstated; observed only.

hubspot:static-auth-access-token.policy: Shared generic detection; Authorization Bearer read as bearer_token; not aliased to the private-app token.
hubspot:static-auth-access-token.unresolved: None asserted beyond the Bearer carrier.

jfrog:pairing-token.policy: A JWT-shaped value is one jwt finding, not a JFrog type; short lifetime does not justify silence.
jfrog:pairing-token.unresolved: String form inferred not stated; non-JWT form unassertable; observed only.

meta:instagram-app-secret.policy: Shared generic detection; client_secret in a POST form and GET query read as contextual_secret; no alias to the Meta app secret.
meta:instagram-app-secret.unresolved: Whether the value equals the Meta app secret.

canva:authorization-code.policy: Ambiguity tier: the code redirect parameter and form field are medium confidence, warn, text unchanged; code_verifier redacts.
canva:authorization-code.unresolved: No must-flag expectation exists for the code; observed only.

meta:app-access-token.policy: Bounded composite claim: access_token as {app-id}|{app-secret} is one span over the whole composite (public app id included).
meta:app-access-token.unresolved: The generated token's response member and format are unassertable.

x:oauth1-access-token.policy: Shared generic detection, the #1241 default; the two halves are separate spans.
x:oauth1-access-token.unresolved: Sensitivity of the token half; observed only.

zoom:build-platform-api-key.policy: x-api-key read as contextual_secret; Bearer as bearer_token; a JWT in either is jwt; no attribution.

zoom:webhook-secret-token.policy: Role is metadata only for the derived outputs; x-zm-signature silent; plainToken/encryptedToken redacted (recorded deviation).
zoom:webhook-secret-token.unresolved: The secret token's carrier (documentation says both sends the secret and sends a hash); controls only.

adobe:service-account-jwt-private-key.policy: Historical-only role; shared generic private_key (PEM) detection, no Adobe type; identifiers and key references are not the key.
adobe:service-account-jwt-private-key.unresolved: Encoding, label and length of the key file; any Adobe marker; whether any key still works; no scored positive.

airtable:legacy-api-key.policy: Historical-only; bounded-context fallback: api_key URL parameter or variable, Bearer value.
airtable:legacy-api-key.unresolved: Prefix, alphabet, length; presentation form; whether a key authenticated after 2024-02-01.

dropbox:legacy-long-lived-access-token.policy: Historical-only (conflicting retirement dates); bounded-context fallback: access_token JSON member, Bearer value; a bare value is silent.
dropbox:legacy-long-lived-access-token.unresolved: Which date applies; whether existing tokens still authenticate; format.

hubspot:legacy-api-key.policy: Historical account key plus a current developer key in one carrier; the hapikey name admitted as a whole-name vocabulary entry (#1225/#1233 rule) with placeholder and mask exclusions, no HubSpot attribution, no era.
hubspot:legacy-api-key.unresolved: Format; UUID-shaped lead; whether a key authenticated after 2022-11-30.

jfrog:api-key.policy: Era-specific, no shutdown claim; whole-name entry for the documented X-JFrog-Art-API header, shared with the reference token and attributing neither; no bare claim.
jfrog:api-key.unresolved: Which form applies to which release; the curl -u password carrier is #1247.

zendesk:api-token.policy: Era-specific lifecycle; the Basic envelope is one authorization_credential span; exact-span policy for the email/token: composition.
zendesk:api-token.unresolved: Token prefix, alphabet, length; whether phase 1 was applied; the curl -u carrier is #1247.

reddit:app-client-secret.policy: Current claims historical-only (Reddit-pointed archived carriers); the Basic envelope is one authorization_credential span; client_secret and REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET are read.
reddit:app-client-secret.unresolved: Format; whether registration still shows a secret; the curl -u carrier is #1247.

reddit:oauth-access-token.policy: Archived (Reddit-pointed) carriers: JSON access_token, URL fragment, lower-case bearer header; token= read with revoke/introspect context.
reddit:oauth-access-token.unresolved: Lifetime as a current fact; expires_in unit; bare token= is the #1241 rule.

reddit:oauth-refresh-token.policy: Archived (Reddit-pointed): the refresh_token body field, never a resource Bearer credential.
reddit:oauth-refresh-token.unresolved: Whether permanent tokens are still issued; lifetime and rotation; format.
